title: Senior Software Engineer - FinTech Platform
job_summary: This Senior Software Engineer role is within a fast-growing FinTech startup, focusing on designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput backend APIs for payment systems. The position requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in backend development, strong proficiency in Python or Go, SQL databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL, and extensive experience with RESTful APIs. The role involves leading a small team, mentoring junior engineers, driving architectural decisions, and troubleshooting production issues. Preferred qualifications include AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, demonstrating extreme ownership, autonomy, adaptability, and a willingness to learn.
